label: run_03_aws_production
_comment: Production study for a 16-vCPU AWS instance (c6i.4xlarge). np=8 targets the 8 physical cores; run --benchmark with np=8 and np=16 first and keep the faster one. Run --benchmark on the instance before committing to the full study. Energy guard: kinetic energy cannot grow in this closed unforced domain, so a rise above 1% of its running minimum stops the level and marks the reliable horizon. Expect levels to stop before T rather than reach it -- that is the intended behaviour, and it bounds the cost automatically.
